verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP/Hog functions and workflows let users define rule-based pipelines that trigger actions (filtering, reshaping, routing) on incoming events, and the MCP docs explicitly show setting up a CDP destination or shipping a feature flag from a natural-language prompt, tying this to AI-native workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that AI-defined rules work reliably in production, and deeper documentation of conditional trigger logic beyond CDP destinations and feature flags.
